answer: A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the jade queue naming the quill that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the zephyr record reveals exactly who is still on probation. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
